''' Lord Sandra M'rfee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was part of the Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an advisor to [[Darth Nox]].
